title: Automated Azure and M365 audit
summary: Reviews identity, access and configuration read-only and delivers a prioritized plan.
lead: A repeatable security assessment that doesn't depend on who runs it.
problem: Assessing the security of an Azure, identity and Microsoft 365 environment by hand takes days, and the result changes with the person doing it.
idea: An audit that runs on its own with read-only permissions, reviews identity, access and configuration, and delivers a prioritized plan ready to present to leadership.
change: Assessments are faster and comparable across clients, and the conversation starts from a clear diagnosis instead of a list of 50 problems.
role: I chose and wrote the 209 identity, access and configuration checks, built them to run with read-only permissions, designed the report with the prioritized plan and present it to clients.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
